mapper.select: SELECT b.*, s.subject_name, i.item_name FROM budget b LEFT JOIN budget_subject s ON b.subject_id = s.subject_id LEFT JOIN budget_item i ON b.item_id = i.item_id WHERE b.budget_id = #{id}
SELECT b.*, s.subject_name, i.item_name FROM budget b LEFT JOIN budget_subject s ON b.subject_id = s.subject_id LEFT JOIN budget_item i ON b.item_id = i.item_id WHERE b.budget_no = #{no}

SELECT b.*, s.subject_name, i.item_name FROM budget b LEFT JOIN budget_subject s ON b.subject_id = s.subject_id LEFT JOIN budget_item i ON b.item_id = i.item_id ORDER BY b.budget_year DESC, b.budget_no

SELECT b.*, s.subject_name, i.item_name FROM budget b LEFT JOIN budget_subject s ON b.subject_id = s.subject_id LEFT JOIN budget_item i ON b.item_id = i.item_id WHERE b.budget_year = #{year} ORDER BY b.budget_no

SELECT b.*, s.subject_name, i.item_name FROM budget b LEFT JOIN budget_subject s ON b.subject_id = s.subject_id LEFT JOIN budget_item i ON b.item_id = i.item_id WHERE b.subject_id = #{subjectId} ORDER BY b.budget_year DESC, b.budget_no

SELECT b.*, s.subject_name, i.item_name FROM budget b LEFT JOIN budget_subject s ON b.subject_id = s.subject_id LEFT JOIN budget_item i ON b.item_id = i.item_id WHERE b.item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY b.budget_year DESC, b.budget_no

SELECT b.*, s.subject_name, i.item_name FROM budget b LEFT JOIN budget_subject s ON b.subject_id = s.subject_id LEFT JOIN budget_item i ON b.item_id = i.item_id WHERE b.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND b.item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY b.budget_year DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO budget (budget_no, budget_name, budget_year, budget_period, subject_id, subject_code, item_id, item_code, budget_amount, create_user) VALUES (#{budgetNo}, #{budgetName}, #{budgetYear}, #{budgetPeriod}, #{subjectId}, #{subjectCode}, #{itemId}, #{itemCode}, #{budgetAmount}, #{createUser})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(b.budget_amount, 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bd.detail_type = 'APPLY' THEN bd.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bd.detail_type = 'PAYOUT' AND (p.source_apply_no IS NULL OR p.source_apply_no = '') THEN bd.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS remaining_amount FROM budget b LEFT JOIN budget_detail bd ON b.subject_id = bd.subject_id AND b.item_id = bd.item_id LEFT JOIN ctrl_payout p ON p.payout_billcode = bd.business_no WHERE b.budget_id = #{budgetId} GROUP BY b.budget_id, b.budget_amount
